semantic_evidence.path_route: CurvePath2 selects only the first or last retained NativeBezierFragment2 incident to the edited vertex, dispatches it through the same BezierParallel2 incidence authority as direct Beziers, and maps a represented local parameter exactly through that span's authored knot interval before trimming the original spline carrier.
semantic_evidence.span_selection: next curves use the first nonzero native span and previous curves use the last; a reversed two-span regression proves the last-span route and exact reversed public parameter transport.
semantic_evidence.source_family_retention: Successful open-path edits retain PolynomialBSpline or Nurbs and their authored public domains; no Bezier replacement is exposed by CurvePath2.
semantic_evidence.region_canonicalization: CurveRegion2 intentionally decomposes authored splines/NURBS into exact native Bezier boundary spans at construction. Region corner editing therefore consumes those canonical spans directly and does not retain or reconstruct the larger authored spline carrier.
semantic_evidence.mixed_interactions: line/spline and line/NURBS chamfer and fillet use complete circle or supporting-line incidence on the incident span.
semantic_evidence.pair_interactions: polynomial-spline/NURBS and all four polynomial/NURBS family pair combinations reach the same exact rational/PH parallel-intersection fast path when their incident spans qualify.
semantic_evidence.materialization_boundary: Represented Real contacts trim the authored spline exactly. A non-Real algebraic trim remains typed Unsupported until the algebraic public result carrier lands; it is neither rounded nor omitted.
semantic_evidence.trim_or_extend: Spline and NURBS spans remain trim-only until projective extension semantics are authoritative.
semantic_evidence.strict_policy: Native-span promotion, incidence, local ordering, public knot transport, and spline subdivision use the caller's STRICT proof policy.
semantic_evidence.approximate_512_policy: The same proof graph runs first; an expression-undecidable spline control blocks under STRICT and completes only after Hyperlimit's shared 512-bit equality terminal, reporting Approximate512Consumed.
